subject: FinSource pilot - MAP security gates & retention ladder
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@finsource.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finsource.com
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + piloting Redwood - security gating overview

Dylan / Jonas —

Thanks for the intro call today. We want to line up a Mutual Action Plan for the FinSource pilot but need to lock the security/compliance gates early so our procurement and legal teams can scope the procurement window. High-level asks from our side:

- SOC 2 timeline: we need to confirm whether Redwood can provide a SOC 2 report (Type II) or if we can rely on an alternate attestation and what the expected delivery timeline is.
- SIG/CAIQ: we'll send the full questionnaire; can Redwood commit to responding to the high-priority sections (data handling, access controls) in two weeks?
- DPA redlines: our legal team may request a few retention carveouts; can we get an initial position from you so we can prioritize internal redlines?
- Data retention: FinSource requires a 30/90/365 retention ladder for different artifact classes (logs, analytics, content). Need confirmation on supported retention windows and any costs.

Would appreciate a short MAP draft that calls these out with owners, dates, and evidence owners so we can present to procurement on Thursday.

Appreciate it —
Alice

--
Alice Monroe
Head of Integrations, FinSource
phone: +1 415 555 0198
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@finsource.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinSource pilot - MAP security gates & retention ladder

Alice —

Thanks for the clear list. Attached is a first-pass MAP spreadsheet (FinSource_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) that maps each gate to an owner, the initial target date, and the evidence artefact we’ll supply. Key notes up front:

- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II for our hosted API environment; we can provide the most recent report under NDA. Target to deliver to FinSource security team: 2025-10-03. Owner: Kimberly Park (security-compliance).
- SIG/CAIQ: we can commit to completing the high-priority sections in 10 business days after we receive the completed questionnaire (owner: Jonas Weber). We’ll supply a partial responses doc (SIG-partial-responses.docx) and escalate any gaps ASAP.
- DPA redlines: Legal will provide a redline guide; initial position on retention carveouts: Redwood supports per-customer retention settings for customer content, logs are on a configurable window with standard tiers (30/90/365). We will flag where custom retention requires on-prem or private deployment.
- Evidence matrix: we’ve sketched a lightweight SOC2 evidence list (SOC2-scope-sketch.pdf) that pairs evidence items to MAP milestones.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll post the MAP draft to the shared link and share DocuSign for signature of the NDA so we can share the SOC 2 report.
2) Jonas will own SIG responses and coordinate with your security contacts.
3) Kim will handle the DPA & retention detail questions and confirm whether any retention carveouts impact pricing or deployment mode.

If that looks good, can you confirm the procurement presentation is Thursday 18 Sep? If so we’ll accelerate the SIG sections you flagged.

Thanks,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@finsource.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinSource pilot - MAP security gates & retention ladder

Alice —

Appreciate the breakdown. A few technical clarifications from my side to make the SIG and SOC2 delivery crisp:

- SOC 2 scope: the report we can share covers our hosted inference control plane and the production inference runtime in us-west-2. If FinSource requires EU residency or on-prem evidence, that will need private deployment or a regional SLA addendum.
- SIG: please highlight the priority sections (we saw you mark Data Flow, Access Control, and Third-Party Risk). I’ll queue those first. Estimated internal turnaround: 8 business days for high-priority items assuming we only need to pull existing artifacts. Where we don’t have direct artifacts we’ll provide mitigations + roadmap.
- DPA/Retention specifics: our platform supports three configurable retention tiers for customer-generated content and logs. Standard pricing accounts for up to the 365-day tier for metadata; extended archival (beyond 365 days or immutable escrow) requires an add-on and may involve different storage modalities.
- Evidence owners: to avoid confusion, I’m mapping evidence to named owners in the spreadsheet. Example: "Access logs export" -> Kimberly Park; "KV cache handling doc" -> SRE.

I’ll start filling high-priority SIG items and upload a SIG-partial-responses.docx by end of next week.

Jonas

Alice —

Attached: FinSource_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (annotated), SOC2-scope-sketch.pdf, SIG-partial-responses.docx.

Quick status update against your asks:
- NDA / SOC2: DocuSign envelope sent (link: https://app.docusign.com/FinSource-FS-2025-412). Once signed we’ll provision the SOC 2 share folder and tag the evidence items that require restricted view.
- Retention rationale (one-liner bullets included in the annotated MAP, excerpt below):
  * Analytics/aggregates (30 days default, up to 365): low sensitivity; retained for model perf tuning.
  * Access logs (90 days default, 365 with approval): retained for incident investigation; >365 requires archival add-on due to indexing/ingest costs.
  * Customer content (30/90/365 configurable): content retention is tenant-configurable; immutable escrow available for enterprise private deployments.
- SIG: Jonas uploaded the first tranche of high-priority answers; I flagged two items that need FinSource confirmation on third-party trust boundaries.

Please let us know if you want a short 20-minute prep call before procurement tomorrow; otherwise we’ll be on standby and can present the MAP as-is.

Best,
Dylan
